**Direct and internal path**
- `ComponentDisposeHelper.EnsureNotDisposed` is the only direct caller. It calls `ThrowDisposed` when the pipeline has been disposed.
- `ResiliencePipeline.InitializeSyncContext` (`ResiliencePipeline.SyncT.cs:168`) calls `EnsureNotDisposed`.
- `ResiliencePipeline.InitializeAsyncContext` (`ResiliencePipeline.AsyncT.cs:207`) calls `EnsureNotDisposed`.
- `ResiliencePipeline.GetSyncContext` calls `InitializeSyncContext`.
- `ResiliencePipeline.GetAsyncContext` calls `InitializeAsyncContext`.

**Public entry points**
- `ResiliencePipeline.Execute`: every overload, in `ResiliencePipeline.Sync.cs` and `ResiliencePipeline.SyncT.cs`, via `GetSyncContext` or `InitializeSyncContext`.
- `ResiliencePipeline.ExecuteAsync`: every overload, in `ResiliencePipeline.Async.cs` and `ResiliencePipeline.AsyncT.cs`, via `GetAsyncContext` or `InitializeAsyncContext`.
- `ResiliencePipeline.ExecuteOutcomeAsync`, in `ResiliencePipeline.AsyncT.cs`, via `InitializeAsyncContext`.
- `ResiliencePipeline<TResult>.Execute`, `ResiliencePipeline<TResult>.ExecuteAsync` and `ResiliencePipeline<TResult>.ExecuteOutcomeAsync`, in `ResiliencePipelineT.Sync.cs` and `ResiliencePipelineT.Async.cs`. These forward to the non-generic `Pipeline.Execute*` calls, so they reach it indirectly.

The graph listed only `InitializeAsyncContext`, `Execute`, `GetSyncContext`, `InitializeSyncContext` and `EnsureNotDisposed`. I added the async public methods, `GetAsyncContext` and the generic wrapper methods from the source.

Two similarly named methods do not reach it. `ResiliencePipelineRegistry.EnsureNotDisposed` and `CircuitStateController.EnsureNotDisposed` are private methods that throw their own `ObjectDisposedException`.

- `test/Polly.Core.Tests/ResiliencePipelineTests.cs` (`DisposeAsync_Allowed_Disposed`, line 55)
- `test/Polly.Core.Tests/Registry/ResiliencePipelineRegistryTests.cs` (lines 430-433, executing pipelines after the registry is disposed)
- `test/Polly.Core.Tests/CircuitBreaker/CircuitBreakerResiliencePipelineBuilderTests.cs` (line 230)
- `test/Polly.RateLimiting.Tests/RateLimiterResiliencePipelineBuilderExtensionsTests.cs` (line 161)

`test/Polly.Core.Tests/ResiliencePipelineBuilderTests.cs` has two tests named `AddPipeline_EnsureNotDisposed`. They dispose pipelines but never assert on `ObjectDisposedException`, so they don't exercise the throw.
